title: Psalm 16
firstLine: Keep me, O God; I trust in Thee. Jehovah, I confess Thou art my Lord; apart from Thee no good do I possess.

lines: Keep me, O God; I trust in Thee. Jehovah, I confess Thou art my Lord; apart from Thee no good do I possess.
I've set the Lord before my face, and Him I'll always see. Because He stands at my right hand I never moved shall be.
Because of this my heart is glad, and joy shall be express'd by all my glory, and my flesh in confidence shall rest.
Because my soul in nether realms shall not be left by Thee; corruption Thou wilt not permit Thy Holy one to see.
Thou wilt me show the path of life. Thy presence holds great store of lasting joy; at Thy right hand are pleasures evermore.
